### Giving away the Gospel
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-jan-11-2011-11643936.html
Passage: Acts 10:9-15
Points:
- Peter felt the tension between familiar legal restrictions and God's sudden grant of freedom.
- The rooftop vision prepared Peter to enter the home of Cornelius and share Christ.
- Christians often fall into the trap of deciding who deserves to hear the gospel.
- The message of grace must be offered freely to everyone rather than withheld.
- God works in unlikely hearts and calls believers to reach people outside their comfort zones.

### Devotional: Acts 10
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/judges-6-acts-10-jeremiah-19-mark-5/
Passage: Acts 10
Points:
- God systematically led the early church beyond traditional Jewish boundaries to reach outsiders.
- Peter initially declined the heavenly command to eat because he still adhered strictly to dietary laws.
- The repeated vision prepared Peter's conscience to enter a Gentile household and proclaim salvation.
- The initiative to bridge racial and cultural divides with the gospel originated from God Himself.
